messages:
maia-devex: Noticed flaky failures in the TypeScript sample app when using function-calling + json_mode. Fails at runtime in our demo.

maia-devex: Error msg: `TypeError: cannot read property 'items' of undefined` — printing response shows structured payload arrived as stringified JSON for the `value` field.

jon-sdks: repro? paste the minimal payload.

maia-devex: raw body: `{ "choices": [{ "message": { "content": { "type": "output_structured", "value": "{\"items\":[{\"id\":1}]}" } } }] }`

jon-sdks: hm, we added a stringify helper a while back to deal with older envs where structured values lost fidelity. Looks like our TS runtime helper isn't unwrapping consistently. Python/Ruby SDKs don't have this issue.

ryan-runtime: We did leave a compatibility shim in the router to accept string-encoded structured payloads. But agree it's messy. We can emit an explicit header `x-redwood-structured-encoding: string|json` so SDKs can handle deterministically.

jon-sdks: short-term fix in TS SDK: detect `json_mode === true` and try JSON.parse for `value` when it's a string. Also add a type guard `isStructuredOutput(obj): obj is StructuredOutput` to make TS ergonomics nicer. I'll draft a tiny patch.

talia-qa: add an e2e that checks both string and object encodings so we don't regress. The flaky demo was caught by our smoke test against `redwood/sample-apps/payments`.

jon-sdks: will add `sdkUtils.parseStructuredValue(value, {coerce: true})` and export it. Also consider `validateSchema(schema, value, {allowStringified: true})`.

maia-devex: would prefer SDK not silently coerce by default; opt-in safer. But show examples in onboarding guide for `coerce: true`.

ryan-runtime: plan: annotate new responses with header and start returning native JSON for newly created tokens. Keep shim for 2 releases before removal. I'll file an ops ticket.

jon-sdks: PR: https://github.com/redwood/js-sdk/pull/1050 (parse helper + tests + docs).

talia-qa: CI note: added failing test to catch this class of issue. Passing once parse helper merged.

ci-bot: release candidate: js-sdk v0.12.4-rc1 -> staging 2026-03-24T05:30Z

maia-devex: follow-ups: add a short blurb in the SDK migration / onboarding about `json_mode` and explain `sdkUtils.parseStructuredValue`. Also update sample-apps README to call helper.

jon-sdks: ack. will add code snippet and TS types.

maia-devex: thanks all :raised_hands:
